description: This line plot illustrates the change in "Missing Step" values over four discrete steps, comparing two methods labeled "0-CoT" and "CoRe". The x-axis, labeled "Step", is linear and ranges from 0 to 4, with integer tick marks at each whole number. The y-axis, labeled "Missing Step", is linear and ranges from approximately 0.845 to 0.860, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.003. The "0-CoT" method is represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, starting at a value of 0.8595 at step 0 and decreasing to 0.845 at step 4. The "CoRe" method is represented by an orange solid line with triangular markers, starting at a value of 0.860 at step 0 and decreasing to 0.848 at step 3, then remaining constant at 0.848 at step 4. Both lines show a general downward trend, with the "CoRe" line beginning at a higher value than "0-CoT" and maintaining a higher value for the first three steps before the "0-CoT" line continues to decline.
